items.title: Manuel "Fess" Manetta Interview, 1957-03-21
items.q: the manager of the place was Arnold Doofusho that put up a lot of money on Harry Wills.

ctx.x: What about Wills? Would he go in the place?

Well, Harry Wills, sure he went in a place like that because the manager of the place was Arnold Doofusho that put up a lot of money on Harry Wills. And he was manager of the place. It was Lala's photo, John Lala's place. But Arnold Doofusho was the manager of it.
Do you know anything about the relationship between John Lala and Pete Lala? Were they?
